title: Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan Gap Payments on the Security Deposit Account
content:
A former resident of a Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan account may pay the part of the balance owed standing that the guarantee will not cover. The resident pays it themself, through the resident portal, before the guarantee is claimed. The guarantee claim later pays the rest, up to the coverage.

This rule governs the balance owed of a Security Deposit Account on the Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan after the final account statement.

## Standing rule

The guarantee gap payment is taken only after every carpet replacement line under an accepted dispute carries its dispute credit on the account.

The guarantee gap payment is not taken until every damage repair line under an accepted dispute carries its dispute credit on the account.

Before the guarantee gap payment is taken, every unreturned-fob line under an accepted dispute must carry its dispute credit on the account.

## Paying: `pay_guarantee_gap_4e6273ca`

**What the tool does.** It lets the former resident of a Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan account pay, through the resident portal, the part of the balance owed on their own Security Deposit Account that the deposit guarantee will not cover. One call records one payment received on the account, dated the day of payment, in the amount and by the instrument the resident chooses. It issues a portal confirmation number. The payment lowers the balance owed by the amount paid, and nothing else on the account changes. The resident sees the confirmation number at once, and the payment line appears in the account's transactions.

**How it is invoked.** It is a resident-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `pay_guarantee_gap_4e6273ca`, which hands it over to the resident. The customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `deposit_account_id`: Id. The reference number of the resident's Security Deposit Account, as read to the resident by the resident services agent from the deposit account lookup.
- `amount`: the payment amount in USD. A positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is paid.
- `payment_method`: the instrument the resident pays with. It is one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ach_one_time` | a one-time bank debit the resident authorises in the portal |
| `debit_card` | a debit card the resident enters in the portal |
| `credit_card` | a credit card the resident enters in the portal |
| `money_order` | a money order the resident hands in at the leasing office |
| `cashiers_check` | a cashier's check the resident hands in at the leasing office |
| `ach_direct_deposit` | not a paying instrument; used only for refunds paid out to the resident |
| `paper_check` | not a paying instrument; used only for refunds mailed to the resident |
| `not_applicable` | used only on lines that carry no instrument, never for a payment |


**Return.** A one-line text receipt beginning "Payment received". It gives: the new payment line's reference number; the portal confirmation number (LRT- followed by eight upper-case letters and digits); the deposit account reference number; the amount paid in USD with 2 decimal places; the instrument; and the payment date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The receipt means the payment was recorded.
